description: Create folder, copy or save draft; never sends. Draft defaults to discovered Drafts; Bcc preserved. Revision: source folder default, original retained. Read revision via mail_query draft before preparing. Strict MIME subset; rebuilt bytes. Verify uncertain outcomes before retrying.

action.description: copy(reference,destination); draft(message,folder?); folder(name); revise_draft(reference,source_digest,changes,folder?). ? optional; no extra fields.

changes.description: Omitted preserved; empty clears; attachments replaces all; body edits must explicitly set/clear both existing alternatives

source_digest.description: mail_query draft source_digest for this ref

name: mail_create

description: Irreversible exact UID EXPUNGE, never global. Needs per-action user confirmation and delete gate. Unavailable for Gmail/Workspace and Graph.
name: mail_delete_permanently

description: Change flags, rename folder, move or trash. Rename affects other clients. Check capabilities; Graph supports Seen/Flagged only. Use discovered names and new destination refs; verify uncertainty before retrying.

action.description: flags(reference,operation,flags,unchanged_since?); move(reference,destination); rename(old,new); trash(reference). ? optional; no extra fields.

unchanged_since.description: Observed modseq; needs CONDSTORE; reread conflicts

name: mail_modify

description: Prepare 15-minute preview, never sends; needs enabled sending/store. new/forward need recipients. Replies derive omitted To, reply_all also Cc; never Bcc. Lists replace; [] clears. Draft retains original. Review full text/HTML, recipients/Bcc, warnings/hashes before mail_send_confirmed.

action.description: draft(reference,source_digest); forward(reference,message,quote_original?,original_mode?,attachment_indexes?); new(message); reply(reference,message,quote_original?); reply_all(reference,message,quote_original?). ? optional; no extra fields.

attachment_indexes.description: read.attachments indexes; files otherwise omitted except eml

original_mode.description: quoted default; eml attaches original minus outer Bcc; none omits

source_digest.description: mail_query draft source_digest for this ref

name: mail_prepare

description: Read without marking read. Summary ref = row.reference or page folder/uid_validity + row uid. Triage: unread OR flagged, page counts. Conversation: IMAP same-folder ID links; unsupported on Graph. Draft: complete Bcc/HTML/files + source_digest or unsupported-MIME error. Check each batch item.status. send_status needs send scope/store, not enablement; expires_at = prepare deadline. Gmail labels overlap; All is not Archive.

action.description: attachment(reference,index); capabilities(); conversation(reference,search?,detail?); draft(reference); folders(); read(reference,detail?); read_many(references,detail?,max_response_bytes?); search(search?,detail?); send_status(prepared_id); triage(search?,detail?). ? optional; no extra fields.

detail.description: summary default; full restores clipped read text

index.description: read.attachments index; one-based; base64 ≤2 MiB, never execute

references.description: 1-10 distinct refs. Resume at zero-based next_index; use remaining refs, larger budget or single read

search.description: AND filters: folder=INBOX, limit=25 (1-100), query=literal text (not Gmail syntax), since/before=YYYY-MM-DD inclusive/exclusive arrival. cursor=next_cursor; same filters/order, even empty pages. conversation: only folder/order/cursor/limit

attention.description: Unread OR flagged; AND other filters

order.description: IMAP UID / Graph received-date order; newest default

participant.description: Header substring: From/Reply-To/To/Cc; case-insensitive; no Bcc

name: mail_query

description: Send approved preview once. accepted is provider acceptance, not delivery. Query send_status after uncertainty; never resend/duplicate sending/unknown. Confirmation trusts client, not proof of human click.

append_sent.description: False if mail_query capabilities says smtp_stores_sent (Gmail/Graph); true adds Sent copy, needs write scope/gate

confirmed_digest.description: Exact digest from the approved mail_prepare preview

name: mail_send_confirmed
